messages:
anya: Quick sync — bringing up 'zephyr-7b' in the catalog. Two blockers: legal license flag and a perf variance seen in staging canary. Who's owning the licensing follow-up?

mike: I can take licensing ping with @liz. I ran the initial perf sweep; median latency is ~8% higher than expected at 512 seq. Might be kv-cache warmup or tensor-slice kernel mismatch.

liz: I saw the license metadata — model card says Apache-2.0 but the weights repo includes a CLA note. Need a short convo with the model host to confirm redistribution rights. I can draft the message. ETA EOD?

anya: EOD sounds good. Can you cc on the message and add the exact files causing the issue? mike — can you paste the perf command you ran?

mike: Sure — here's what I used:```bash
python perf_profile.py --model zephyr-7b --batch 8 --seq 512 --tokens 1024 --warmup 50
```

mike: The run shows one-off tails in 95p that correlate with mem alloc spikes. Suspecting quant path fallback on certain attention blocks.

ron: I can instrument runtime traces for the next canary and add kernel selection logs. If it's kernel fallback, we should see it. I'll need a canary window though — when's the next canary?

anya: Planning canary tomorrow 09:00 PT for 2 hours. Want to keep it short, then expand if green. Ron, that window works?

ron: Works for me. I'll add tracing hooks and a lightweight perf dashboard.

devex-bot: @anya You have an outstanding PR: github.com/redwood-inference/registry/pull/1423 — adds zephyr-7b metadata and default perf profile. CI: failing lint.

anya: Thanks bot. @sam can you take the PR lint fix? Small YAML whitespace issue.

sam: On it, will push a fix in ~20m.

liz: For legal note — I'll prepare a template email to the repo owner asking to confirm redistribution and any CLA exceptions. If they don't reply in 48h we should gate catalog publish. OK?

mike: That sounds reasonable. We should still be able to stage the model in internal-only catalog for teams with NDA while legal confirms.

anya: Good call. Add a 'private-preview' flag on the catalog entry. Devex — will that break onboarding flow?

devex-bot: private-preview flag accepted. UI will hide public listing. You can toggle via the console feature flag.

sam: PR fix pushed: lint + small metadata key rename. CI now green. link: github.com/.../pull/1423

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by anya at 2024-06-15T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Notifying eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra.

ron: Will start traces 10min before canary. Also adding a bucketed histogram for alloc spikes.

mike: FYI I also ran a small quantized A/B: q4_0 vs q4_1 — q4_1 reduced 95p by ~3% but added small hallucination artifacts in a few prompts. Want to log these in evals.

anya: Can you add those sample prompts + outputs to the eval set and mark as 'sensitive-quality' so we can decide threshold?

mike: Will do. PR to evals repo when ready.

liz: Quick legal note — if the model host confirms redistribution but requires attribution, we must add a model attribution banner in the catalog UI. Paging @devex for implementation.

sam: I can add UI banner slot. Need copy from legal.

liz: Draft: "Model weights provided by Zephyr Labs — redistribution permitted under Apache-2.0 with attribution." Happy to iterate.

anya: Great. Action items recap: 1) liz to send repo owner legal confirmation email (EOD) 2) mike to add eval prompts + perf notes (today) 3) ron to enable runtime traces for canary (tomorrow canary) 4) sam to merge metadata lint fix (done) 5) devex to add private-preview flag + UI banner slot (in progress) 6) anya to flip canary and coordinate infra (tomorrow)

sam: Can we add a dependency tag in the PR linking to infra traces so reviewers can easily see traces?

ron: I'll post a GCS link with trace bundles after the canary. Add it in PR description or checklist.

mike: One more thing — model card missing tokenizer provenance. If tokenizer requires non-commercial embedding license we might need an extra check. I'll add tokenizers.json diff in PR.

liz: Good catch. I'll add tokenizer provenance to the legal checklist.

anya: Thanks team. If legal clears quickly we can move to public catalog next week; otherwise we'll keep private-preview until cleared.

mike: I'll monitor perf and post updates in this thread after canary. :eyes:

liz: Email drafted, sending now. cc: anya, mike. :thumbsup:

anya: Awesome — closing async sync for now. If anything urgent, ping me directly.

devex-bot: Thread archived (metadata updated).
